result.markdown:
For a small online store, my recommendation is **Stripe for flexibility or Shopify Payments if you're using Shopify**\.

If you're operating in Australia, there are also some particularly competitive options worth considering, especially Airwallex.

Here's how I'd compare the main providers.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best all-rounder)

- Easy integration with most online stores.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent subscriptions, invoicing and reporting.
- No standard monthly processing fee.

Indicative Australian domestic card fee: around 1.7% + A\$0.30. | Provider | Domestic online fee (indicative) | Best for |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Airwallex | 1.65% + \$0.30 | Lower fees, international |
| Stripe | 1.70% + \$0.30 | Flexibility |
| Shopify Payments | 1.75% + \$0.30 | Shopify stores |
| Square | 2.2% | Online and in-person |
| PayPal | 2.90% + \$0.30 | Customer familiarity |


Rates are indicative Australian rates; check the provider's current pricing and any additional fees before signing up. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/compare-payment-systems-for-small-businesses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

- **Starting a new store\:** Stripe.
- **Already using Shopify\:** Shopify Payments.
- **Selling overseas\:** Airwallex.
- **Want another familiar checkout option\:** Add PayPal alongside your main processor.
